mostWorthwhile.text: Transferring the cooler to reserve power was the most worthwhile moment: the logger confirmed it survived the change, and Eli's relief made the work consequential.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the backup unit and then its battery felt a little procedural, although the distinction between a circuit and a power source was clear.

surprise.text: The load measurement included cycling peaks, not just the average, changing how I understood the reserve requirement.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the carrier steps were straightforward but clearly served the collection goal.

continue.text: I would continue: the practical repair details and the clinic's stakes held my interest, even if some of the setup was procedural.
